overview: This page is the Metronome documentation home page, linking to guidance on how Metronome works, getting to a first invoice, and planning a billing architecture. It presents four pricing and packaging paths: pay-as-you-go billing, enterprise commits, subscriptions with usage, and prepaid credits. It also provides starting points for contracts, invoicing, and revenue recognition.
key_takeaways: The page directs readers to guides covering Metronome's core parts, a dashboard quickstart, and billing-architecture planning.
Pay-as-you-go billing supports charging customers in arrears for only what they use.
Enterprise commits address prepaid and postpaid commitments, negotiated discounts, one-time charges, and contract renewals.
Subscriptions with usage combine recurring revenue with usage-based components.
Prepaid credits allow upfront credit purchases with auto-recharge or gated access when credits run out.
